sentences.en: Joe Sanders has the most beautiful garden in our town.
sentences.zh: 乔·桑德斯拥有我们镇上最漂亮的花园。

sentences.en: Bill Frith's garden is larger than Joe's.
sentences.zh: 比尔·弗里斯的花园比乔的花园大。

sentences.en: Bill works harder than Joe and grows more flowers and vegetables.
sentences.zh: 比尔比乔也更为勤奋，种植的花卉和蔬菜也更多。

article.en: Joe Sanders has the most beautiful garden in our town.
article.zh: 乔·桑德斯拥有我们镇上最漂亮的花园。

article.en: Nearly everybody enters for 'The Nicest Garden Competition' each year, but Joe wins every time.
article.zh: 几乎每个人都参加每年举办的“最佳花园竞赛”，而每次都是乔获胜。

article.en: Bill Frith's garden is larger than Joe's.
article.zh: 比尔·弗里斯的花园比乔的花园大。

article.en: Bill works harder than Joe and grows more flowers and vegetables.
article.zh: 比尔比乔也更为勤奋，种植的花卉和蔬菜也更多。
但乔的花园更富有情趣。

article.en: He has made neat paths and has built a wooden bridge over a pool.
article.zh: 他修筑了一条条整洁的小路，并在一个池塘上架了一座小木桥。

article.en: I like gardens too, but I do not like hard work.
article.zh: 我也喜欢花园，但我却不愿意辛勤劳动。

article.en: Every year I enter for the garden competition too.
article.zh: 每年的花园竞赛我也参加。

article.en: I always win a little prize for the worst garden in the town!
article.zh: 而且总因是镇上最差的花园而获得一个小奖！
